On the occasion of Mahakumbh 2025 presenting:
Tandavam aka 'The Shiv Tandav Stotram', attributed to Ravana, glorifies Lord Shiva's cosmic dance of Tandav, symbolizing creation, preservation, and destruction. Through 16 rhythmic verses, it vividly describes Shiva's divine form, adorned with matted locks, ash, serpents, and the crescent moon, while invoking his boundless grace and power. Chanting this hymn is believed to bestow mental peace, strength, and spiritual liberation.
Rishab covers 4 of these 16 verses in his performance of Tandavam, available to stream on all digital platfroms.
